name: BARC Shelter (Brooklyn Animal Resource Coalition)
notes:
501(c)(3) no-kill, privately funded, in Williamsburg since 1987 - one of Brooklyn's oldest WALK-IN shelters (253 Wythe Ave 11211), receives no government subsidy. Dogs + cats. Adoption hours Tue-Sat 12-4pm (closed Mon); runs a pet-supply store whose profits fund the shelter. Adopters must be 21+, complete the application, bring 2 valid IDs (photo + proof of address) + 2 non-family references + vet reference, and bring any resident dog/kids to meet. Post-pandemic also does outreach assisting other rescues. Email: (via site contact form) Intake: Adopt: walk-in Tue-Sat 12-4 Intake: App required

Its website no longer works: barcshelter.com no longer exists, and barcshelter.org now leads to an unrelated gambling site - do not use it. The phone number, (718) 486-7489, is also on the city's own list of shelters that help people keep their pets. The building is on the corner of Wythe Ave and N 1st St (also given as 86 N 1st St). Listings disagree on whether it opens Saturdays, so ring before you go.

change_log.note: barcshelter.com has no DNS record any more; barcshelter.org resolves but redirected to a gambling site on 2026-11-03. Link removed so nobody is sent there. Reported by a reviewer.

Its own site, which confirmed it in August, is gone. The phone is confirmed independently by the city DHS page; the address comes from the research and a business directory a reviewer found (brooklyndirect.us), whose 86 N 1st St is the same corner building (40 m apart by the Census geocoder). The named contact person on that directory is not published.
